title: HARP: Efficient Data Selection for Finetuning Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.07690v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Finetuning data selection requires balancing two competing goals: selecting examples that improve the downstream objective, and doing so without repeatedly finetuning models. Train-free selectors are scalable but rely on proxies such as embedding similarity or clustering, which may not match the target objective. Train-based selectors better reflect downstream utility through gradient signals, subset evaluation, or Shapley attribution, but require many costly train-evaluate iterations. We propose Hierarchical Active Region Pruning (HARP), an efficient train-based selector that preserves downstream alignment while reducing selection cost. HARP organizes the training pool into a node-leaf hierarchy, evaluates only representative leaves, and infers unmeasured utilities with empirical Bayes posteriors. translated_title: HARP：面向大语言模型微调的高效数据选择方法
translated_abstract: 微调数据选择需要在两个相互冲突的目标之间取得平衡：既要选出能提升下游任务表现的样本，又要避免反复对模型进行微调。免训练选择器具有良好的可扩展性，但依赖嵌入相似度或聚类等代理指标，这些指标可能与目标objective不匹配；基于训练的选择器通过梯度信号、子集评估或Shapley归因能更好地反映下游效用，但需要大量代价高昂的训练-评估迭代。我们提出了分层主动区域剪枝方法（HARP），这是一种高效的基于训练的选择器，能够在降低选择成本的同时保持下游对齐效果。HARP将训练数据池组织为节点-叶节点层次结构，仅评估具有代表性的叶节点，并利用经验贝叶斯后验推断未测量的数据效用。随后，它使用两个互补的包络策略进行数据选择：HARP-C以保守方式控制数据冗余，HARP-E则以加性方式……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于训练的高效数据选择方法HARP，它将训练数据组织为层次结构、仅评估代表性子集并用经验贝叶斯后验推断其余数据的效用，配合互补的冗余控制与加性选择策略，在大幅降低选择成本的同时保持下游任务对齐效果。
en_tdlr: HARP is an efficient train-based data selection method that organizes the training pool into a node-leaf hierarchy, evaluates only representative leaves, infers unmeasured utilities via empirical Bayes posteriors, and selects data with complementary redundancy-controlling and additive envelopes, achieving downstream alignment at greatly reduced selection cost.
